capture_method: Scripts/capture-screenshots.sh --stills-only in an isolated git archive of the master commit, with the script's light default and the scripted-capture sidebar selection from LokalBot/Views/MainWindowView.swift applied
isolation: Separate archive, temporary storage root and UserDefaults suite, and path-specific DerivedData. Prebuilt native runtimes were copied into the archive's Vendor directory. The script's pkill matches only 'LokalBot UI Test Host' processes. Installed app and user library were not used.
capture_script_adjustments: Default appearance changed from dark to light.
Scripted captures draw the selected sidebar row with NSColor.unemphasizedSelectedContentBackgroundColor, because cacheDisplay renders the native highlight solid black.

demo.narration: ElevenLabs Eleven v4 (eleven_v4), premade male voice Liam; synthetic
demo.context: 0-15 s motion graphics drawn in the composition; 15-45 s real native app recordings in light appearance, driven by scripted AppKit input in the isolated UI test host with fictional seed data. Cursor, ripples, headlines and model chips are overlays.

known_render_limits: cacheDisplay draws the selected toolbar segment in meetings-summary.png as a blank light pill
cacheDisplay draws selected sidebar rows as solid black
known_limits: The selected toolbar segment in meetings-summary.png renders as a blank white pill under cacheDisplay.
The host was not the active app, so window chrome and switches use the inactive appearance.
